notes.title: 🛠️ Update v0.3.1 – General Demo Polishing Part 1
notes.notes:
In this update, we made broad improvements across the demo:

Visual adjustments to the menus for a smoother experience

Enhanced attack effects and added enemy particle effects for better visual feedback

Improvements to core systems and various bug fixes

Added a new ability: Dash

Introduced a new relic: Dash

notes.title: 🛠️ Update v0.2.7 — Fixes & Balancing (Part 1)
notes.notes:
⚖️ Balancing
Enemy speed, damage, and health have been adjusted to make fights feel more fair and consistent.

Player's starting damage was way too high — that's been fixed to keep the early game from being too easy.

🎨 Visual Improvements
Card effects have been updated to be clearer and feel better.

Small camera tweaks to improve how things look during gameplay.

notes.title: 🛠️ Update v0.2.6 — Demo polish update
notes.notes:
Improvements to visual feedback and gameplay mechanics:
-effects when selecting cards
-the number of damages when hitting enemies has had its animation improved
-camera effects
-colddown of enemy spawns
-card descriptions remain visible at all times
